brief:
Israeli occupation forces arrested Hassan Jamjoum, a young man from the village of Al-Issawiya northeast of occupied Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. Details surrounding the arrest remain unclear, with no immediate information available about the circumstances or any charges filed against him.

Al-Issawiya, located in the northern reaches of the occupied Palestinian capital, has experienced recurring tensions between residents and Israeli security forces. The village has been the site of repeated clashes and military operations over recent years, as Israeli forces maintain a significant presence in the area.
